Residents:
Felix (student, early 20s): Out for classes approx 08:40–14:30 daily. Studies at home in the afternoon/evening. Hobbies: board games, cycling, family calls, reading.
Aisha (retired, 60s): Home most of the day. Morning walk, afternoon errands. Hobbies: cycling, gaming, photography. Cares for the household dog.

Notes:
No movements recorded on Day 0. Items remain in initial walkthrough positions. Felix’s cycling gear (helmet, jacket, bike lock) and Aisha’s cycling gear (helmet, jacket, bike lock) are stored in the entry, suggesting they are used for daily outings. Dog items (leash, bowl, food, toy) are distributed between entry, kitchen, and living areas. Aisha’s camera is on the living room bookshelf. Felix’s laptop is on the entry floor, likely moved to the desk or kitchen table for study sessions.
